verified_observations: PrivateJournal.kt:20-24/60 serializes per-path read/write operations across separate instances through bounded canonical-path lock stripes. Atomic writes invoke finishWrite on success and failWrite on thrown exceptions at lines 69-75; legacy read migration re-enters the same JVM monitor safely. key() takes a separate synchronized class monitor and does not acquire journal locks.

MainViewModel.kt:59-64/79-84/117-124 consistently takes BatchDraft.protocolLock before queue operations. The actor compares durable snapshot tokens before updates/handoffs. Queue task and acceptance receipt are committed together, while acceptance receipt cleanup follows durable draft-row removal, protecting the cross-journal crash windows.

DownloadQueue commits disk state before replacing active/acceptedBatch/StateFlow snapshots. TaskTimeline likewise serializes read-modify-write under its own Mutex; unrelated journal operations do not establish a demonstrated reverse lock path.

Current FailureJournal.saveAndDiscard coordinates failure-lock -> queue-lock ownership and journal eviction before deletion. The known retained-partial eviction/tombstone work being edited by reviewer51 was not reported again.

PublicationReceipt writes its plan before external creation and verified state before provider publication; ambiguous publication results retain a recoverable receipt and do not delete verified documents.

PrivateJournalTest and ConcurrentJournalTest source cover encrypted migration/tamper preservation and separate-instance concurrent full-snapshot reads/writes. BatchHandoffTest source covers failed acceptance/removal, process-like cold reload, stale actors and snapshot-token checks. These were read, not run.
